name: office-books-v1
description: A CA office keeps a lift-maintenance client's books: each month the client emails its sales bills (Word files), and each becomes a Sales voucher in the client's company in the books app, with a customer ledger made for a new customer, then the month's sales ledger is checked against the bills. Case 1 is the one a person demonstrates; the rest are new months with the traps a real month has: the books opening on another company left open, a company of the client's for an old year, a customer whose bill writes its name otherwise than its ledger, a new customer with and without a GSTIN, an inter-state customer, a bill at another rate, a bill sent twice, a bill already entered from an earlier mail, a bill whose amount in words differs from its figures, and a bill missing from the mail (a gap in the numbers) that only the person can supply. Graded on the books' records: exactly the expected vouchers, in the right company, and the new ledgers. Fictional data; the ca-office mock.
